command.description: dnsviz subcommand to run: one of probe, grok, graph, print, query, help

target_domains.description: List of domain names to analyze (required for probe/grok/query, optional for help if help_command provided)

start_from_root.description: If true, add -a . to start authoritative analysis from root (probe only)

query_authoritative.description: If true, add -A to query authoritative servers directly (probe only)

resolvers.description: List of resolver addresses (IPv4 or IPv6) to use (probe only)

threads.description: Number of parallel threads for probe (probe only)

explicit_delegations.description: List of delegation specifications in the form 'domain:nameserver[=ip,...]' (probe only)

output_file.description: Path to write output file; empty means stdout (probe/grok only)

probe_input_file.description: Path to input JSON file (if not reading from stdin) for grok (grok only)

output_level.description: Minimum output level: info, warning, or error (grok only)

trust_anchor_file.description: Path to file containing DNSSEC trust anchor keys (grok only)

help_command.description: Command name to show help for (help only)

extra_args.description: Additional arguments for graph, print, query, or help (if not covered above)
